description: This file contains a shell script designed to test the 'git stash' command with specific options: '--pathspec-from-file' and '--pathspec-file-nul'. It sets up a git repository, defines helper functions, and runs a series of tests to verify the behavior of stashing files based on pathspecs provided via files, including error handling cases.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to the checkpoint tag to restore the initial state.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies that the current git stash show matches the expected output.
